description.value: Starting at 4th level, a geomancer can use movement powers which harness the power of the elements to traverse terrains easily. Each movement power can be used as a swift action, lasting 1 round per geomancer level. The geomancer can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Wisdom modifier. Burrow: tunnel through dirt (not rock) at 10 ft + 10 ft per four geomancer levels after 4th, cannot charge or run while burrowing. Climb: +8 racial bonus on Climb checks, can always take 10, climbs at 10 ft + 10 ft per four geomancer levels after 4th (double speed at -5 penalty for accelerated climb). Float: traverse impeding terrain (water, lava, ice) floating 5 feet off ground, moves at half base land speed. Fly: fly (perfect) at 20 ft + 20 ft per four geomancer levels after 4th with light load, +8 racial bonus on Fly checks. Swim: move through water at swim speed without Swim checks, +8 circumstance bonus on Swim checks for special actions, can take 10, run while swimming in a straight line, swims at 10 ft + 10 ft per four geomancer levels after 4th.
